# Dr Sabiha — Homeopathic Consultations

Dr Sabiha is a DHMS-qualified Homeopathic Physician offering personalized
homeopathic consultations in a private, home-based setting.

## Consultations

- Skin & hair consultations
- Digestive health consultations
- Allergy consultations
- Women's health consultations
- Stress & wellness consultations
- Respiratory health consultations
- Joint & muscle care consultations

Consultations focus on understanding each patient's health concerns,
lifestyle, and individual needs in a comfortable, one-on-one setting.

- Location: Lucknow Society Ls 15
- Booking: use the appointment form on the site (#book) or call directly

  Materia Medica course, six months clinical training)
- #book — appointment booking form

## Credentials (as listed on site)

- Diploma in Homoeopathic Medical Science (DHMS)
- Registered with the National Council for Homoeopathy
  (registration and renewal certificates listed)
- Advanced study in Homoeopathic Materia Medica
- Six months practical clinical training in patient care
